item.beyondsolo.ascension_key.lore: A key the System handed you. It opens a door that is not there.
item.beyondsolo.ascension_key.use: Use: begin the Trial of Ascension
quest.beyondsolo.job_ascension.desc: You have grown enough to advance. Use the Key of Ascension and clear the trial alone. What you become will be decided there.
notify.beyondsolo.job_unlocked.title: [Job Change]
notify.beyondsolo.job_unlocked.body: You qualify for a job change. Use the Key of Ascension when you are ready.
notify.beyondsolo.job_countdown.title: Trial of Ascension
notify.beyondsolo.job_countdown.body: Entering the trial. You will face it alone.
notify.beyondsolo.job_changed.title: Job change complete
notify.beyondsolo.job_changed.body: %s has advanced to %s. New skills unlocked.
notify.beyondsolo.job_done.title: Job change
notify.beyondsolo.job_locked.title: Job change
notify.beyondsolo.job_wait.title: Trial of Ascension
notify.beyondsolo.job_wait.body: The trial is sealed for %s:%s more.
notify.beyondsolo.job_not_here.title: Trial of Ascension
notify.beyondsolo.job_returned.title: Trial of Ascension
notify.beyondsolo.job_returned.body: You left the trial. You can try again.
chat.beyondsolo.job_rare: The System trembles: %s has become a %s!
job.beyondsolo.trial.title: TRIAL OF ASCENSION
job.beyondsolo.trial.intro: Defeat the Echoes. Face the Arbiter. Prove you deserve to advance.
job.beyondsolo.trial.boss_near: Something stirs at the far end of the hall.
job.beyondsolo.trial.arbiter_flawless: Flawless so far: don't get hit, and the rare odds double
job.beyondsolo.trial.failed_sub: The System casts you out. You may try again in %s minutes.
job.beyondsolo.reveal.title: JOB CHANGE
job.beyondsolo.reveal.shadows: The shadows answer to you now. Their army will come.
subclass.beyondsolo.bloodrager.desc: Trades blood for fury: the more it bleeds, the harder it hits, and every strike drinks some life back.
subclass.beyondsolo.warlord.desc: A commander on the battlefield. Plants banners that steel allies and break the enemy's will.
subclass.beyondsolo.blademaster.desc: Pure sword discipline. A storm of cuts faster than the eye can follow.
subclass.beyondsolo.juggernaut.desc: Cannot be stopped, cannot be moved. Charges through anything in its path.
subclass.beyondsolo.worldbreaker.desc: One in a hundred warriors. Its fists split the earth and its blood runs like a titan's.
subclass.beyondsolo.nightblade.desc: Strikes from behind in the dark and finishes what is already wounded.
subclass.beyondsolo.toxin_weaver.desc: Weaves poison into the air and into every cut.
subclass.beyondsolo.mirage_dancer.desc: Never where the enemy aims. Blinks from foe to foe in a flurry of afterimages.
subclass.beyondsolo.bounty_reaper.desc: Marks a target, hunts it down, and is paid in full when it falls.
subclass.beyondsolo.eclipse_sovereign.de: One in a hundred assassins. Swallows the battlefield in darkness and rends everything inside it.
subclass.beyondsolo.pyromancer.desc: Calls pillars of fire from the ground and sets every foe it touches alight.
subclass.beyondsolo.stormcaller.desc: Lightning that leaps from foe to foe, and a body that hums with mana.
subclass.beyondsolo.tidecaller.desc: Commands crashing waves that sweep enemies away, and a deep well of mana.
subclass.beyondsolo.necromancer.desc: Speaks with the dead. Drains the life of its foes, and one day will raise an army of shadows.
subclass.beyondsolo.starborn_archon.desc: One in a hundred mages. Pulls stars from the sky and folds space into a crushing void.
subclass.beyondsolo.paladin.desc: A holy shield. Smites with light, mends itself, and is deadly to the undead.
subclass.beyondsolo.ironwall_sentinel.de: Roots itself like a fortress and turns every blow back on the attacker.
subclass.beyondsolo.spellward_warden.des: A barrier against magic that turns the damage it takes into mana.
subclass.beyondsolo.vengeance_knight.des: Stores up every wound and returns it twice over in a burst of fire.
subclass.beyondsolo.everlasting_colossus: One in a hundred guardians. Grows to a giant's size and refuses to fall.
subclass.beyondsolo.lightbinder.desc: Bursts of radiant light that heal allies and burn foes.
subclass.beyondsolo.grovekeeper.desc: Grows healing gardens that root enemies in place.
subclass.beyondsolo.spring_oracle.desc: A cleansing tide that washes away poison and curses, and a step ahead of every blow.
subclass.beyondsolo.hemomancer.desc: Heals by bleeding others: siphons life straight from the enemy's veins.
subclass.beyondsolo.dawn_saint.desc: One in a hundred healers. A miracle in human form: restores everyone and judges the dead.
subclass.beyondsolo.sharpshooter.desc: One shot, one kill. Piercing shots from impossible range.
subclass.beyondsolo.wildcaller.desc: Fights alongside a pack of wolves that answers its call.
subclass.beyondsolo.snare_artisan.desc: Lays fields of snares and punishes anything caught in them.
subclass.beyondsolo.storm_archer.desc: Volleys of arrows charged with lightning that arcs between foes.
subclass.beyondsolo.heavenpiercer.desc: One in a hundred rangers. An arrow that splits the sky, and a storm of a thousand more.
skill.beyondsolo.blood_frenzy.desc: Spend 10% of your health to rage for %s s: Strength %s, Speed I, and melee hits heal you for %s%% of the damage.
skill.beyondsolo.rage_engine.flavour: The closer to death, the stronger.
skill.beyondsolo.rage_engine.desc: Below half health you deal %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.banner_of_conquest.desc: Plant a war banner for %s s: allies nearby gain Strength and Resistance, foes are weakened and slowed.
skill.beyondsolo.thousand_cuts.desc: Five rapid slashes in front of you, %s damage each.
skill.beyondsolo.unstoppable_charge.desc: Charge %s blocks forward, hurling everything in your path into the air for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.cataclysm_fist.desc: Leap and crash down: %s damage in a huge circle, foes are launched and stunned, then two aftershocks roll out.
skill.beyondsolo.fault_line.desc: The ground erupts in a line ahead of you, %s damage to everything it throws up.
skill.beyondsolo.titan_blood.desc: +%s%% damage with everything and +%s max health.
skill.beyondsolo.umbral_execution.desc: Blink behind the creature you look at and strike for %s damage; 2.5x on targets under 30% health.
skill.beyondsolo.miasma_cloud.desc: A poison cloud for %s s: %s damage per second and heavy poison buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.mirage_flurry.desc: Blink between up to %s nearby foes, striking each for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.evasive_step.desc: %s%% chance to dodge an attack completely.
skill.beyondsolo.death_sentence.desc: Mark a creature for 10 s: it takes %s%% more damage from you. If it dies, Death Sentence is ready again and you gain 20 mana.
skill.beyondsolo.opening_strike.desc: +%s%% damage to targets at 90% health or more.
skill.beyondsolo.total_eclipse.desc: Darkness swallows everything within 10 blocks for 8 s: foes are blinded, slowed and cut for %s damage each second; you vanish and deal 40% more.
skill.beyondsolo.void_rend.desc: Tear through up to 8 foes nearby, striking each for %s damage, then return to where you stood.
skill.beyondsolo.inferno_pillar.desc: A pillar of fire erupts where you look: %s damage, heavy burn buildup, and foes are thrown up.
skill.beyondsolo.chain_lightning.desc: A bolt that deals %s damage and leaps to %s foes in all, a little weaker each jump.
skill.beyondsolo.tidal_crash.desc: A wave crashes ahead: %s damage, foes swept back and slowed, and you recover a little health.
skill.beyondsolo.soul_harvest.desc: Drain every foe around you for %s damage; heal %s and restore 3 mana for each one hit.
skill.beyondsolo.grave_pact.desc: Each kill heals %s and restores %s mana.
skill.beyondsolo.astral_cataclysm.desc: %s stars fall where you look, %s damage each.
skill.beyondsolo.singularity.desc: A point of void pulls in every foe within 9 blocks for 4 s, then collapses for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.celestial_core.desc: +%s max mana, mana regeneration, and +%s%% damage with spells.
skill.beyondsolo.holy_judgment.desc: Smite the creature you look at for %s damage (more against the undead) and heal yourself.
skill.beyondsolo.devotion.desc: +%s armor; below half health you regenerate %s health per second.
skill.beyondsolo.fortress_stance.desc: Root yourself for %s s: Resistance III, and attackers take 30% of their damage back.
skill.beyondsolo.mana_barrier.desc: A barrier of %s absorption health for 12 s; half the damage you take while it lasts comes back as mana.
skill.beyondsolo.retribution.desc: For 6 s you store the damage you take, then explode for twice that plus %s, setting foes alight.
skill.beyondsolo.burning_spite.desc: Creatures that hit you get %s burn buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.colossus_form.desc: Grow to a giant for %s s: +%s max health, much stronger blows, and nothing can push you.
skill.beyondsolo.earthen_domain.desc: A quake through everything within 12 blocks: %s damage, a long stun, and every foe turns on you while you shrug it off.
skill.beyondsolo.undying.desc: A blow that would kill you leaves you at half health instead (once every %s s). +%s max health.
skill.beyondsolo.radiant_burst.desc: Heal allies around you for %s and burn foes for the same (more against the undead).
skill.beyondsolo.blessed_aura.desc: You and allies near you regenerate %s health per second.
skill.beyondsolo.verdant_bloom.desc: A garden for %s s: allies inside heal %s per second, foes are rooted.
skill.beyondsolo.photosynthesis.desc: Regenerate %s health per second under the open sky by day.
skill.beyondsolo.cleansing_tide.desc: A tide that cleanses poison, curses and burns from allies around you and heals them for %s, pushing foes back.
skill.beyondsolo.foresight.desc: +%s max mana and %s%% chance to dodge an attack.
skill.beyondsolo.blood_siphon.desc: Drain the creature you look at for %s damage and blood buildup, healing half of it.
skill.beyondsolo.crimson_vigor.desc: +%s max health; your hits add %s blood buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.miracle_of_dawn.desc: Fully heals and cleanses every ally within 16 blocks and shields them; the undead nearby take %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.judgment_of_dawn.desc: %s pillars of light strike the foes around you, %s damage each.
skill.beyondsolo.eternal_grace.desc: Regenerate %s health per second, and survive a killing blow once every %s s.
skill.beyondsolo.deadeye_shot.desc: A piercing shot along your sight, %s damage to everything in the line.
skill.beyondsolo.call_of_the_pack.desc: Summon %s wolves to fight at your side for 30 s.
skill.beyondsolo.snare_field.desc: Scatter snares for 7 s: foes inside are rooted and take %s damage per second.
skill.beyondsolo.field_craft.flavour: A slowed target is an easy one.
skill.beyondsolo.thunder_volley.desc: Fire five charged shots in a fan, %s damage each, every hit arcing to a nearby foe.
skill.beyondsolo.charged_quiver.desc: +%s%% projectile damage and %s%% chance for a hit to spark for extra damage.
skill.beyondsolo.heavens_arrow.desc: One arrow that pierces everything for 80 blocks, %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.storm_of_a_thousand.des: %s arrows rain down on a wide area where you look.
